name: Data Quality, Governance & Observability
description: Automated data quality validation (Great Expectations, Soda), anomaly detection, end-to-end data lineage (OpenLineage), metadata catalogs (DataHub, Amundsen), Data Observability, data contracts, and GDPR/PII masking.

subskills.name: Data Quality Validation (Great Expectations & Soda)
subskills.description: Expectation Suites in Great Expectations (GX), Checkpoints, Data Docs, Soda Core / SodaCL checks, and pipeline assertion gates.

subskills.name: Data Profiling & Volume/Schema Anomaly Detection
subskills.description: Automated statistical profiling (ydata-profiling), missingness rates, distribution drift, volume drop detection, and fresh data checks.

subskills.name: Data Lineage & OpenLineage Standard
subskills.description: Dataset and job-level lineage collection, OpenLineage specification, Marquez backend, tracking lineage across Airflow, Spark, and dbt.

subskills.name: Enterprise Data Catalogs (DataHub, Amundsen)
subskills.description: Metadata ingestion, automated schema harvesting, data ownership tagging, business glossary management, and search in DataHub or Amundsen.

subskills.name: Data Observability Pillars & Incident Management
subskills.description: Five pillars of data observability (Freshness, Distribution, Volume, Schema, Lineage), root-cause analysis, Monte Carlo, and automated incident alerts.

subskills.name: Data Contracts & Producer-Consumer Schemas
subskills.description: Defining Data Contracts between software engineers and data teams (YAML schema, SLAs, semantics), contract CI validation, and breaking change prevention.

subskills.name: Data Privacy, GDPR Compliance & PII Masking
subskills.description: Right to be Forgotten implementations, pseudonymization, hashing (SHA-256 with salt), dynamic data masking, tokenization, and PII detection.

subskills.name: Data Access Governance (RBAC & ABAC Policies)
subskills.description: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC), row-level security (RLS), column-level masking policies, and Apache Ranger.

subskills.name: Data Retention, Archival & Purge Lifecycles
subskills.description: Designing legal data retention periods, automated cold tier archival, scheduled purge routines, and compliance auditing.

cv.signal: Implemented enterprise data quality framework with Great Expectations and established DataHub catalog

linkedin.signal: Data Governance, Quality & Compliance specialist endorsement

assessment.signal: Passes Data Quality, Governance, Observability & Privacy Assessment

junior.description: Writes automated test assertions with Great Expectations / Soda, profiles statistical data distributions, and enforces retention rules.

mid.description: Connects lineage metadata with OpenLineage, registers assets in DataHub, masks PII to ensure GDPR compliance, and implements row/column security policies.

senior.description: Architects end-to-end Data Observability frameworks, establishes cross-team Data Contracts, and leads enterprise data governance initiatives.
